question: Should maintainers require live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merging this container-classification change, or accept the reporter-sample risk?
rationale: The code-level fix is narrow and source-reproducible, but only live Cloudflare Sandbox output can prove the platform cgroup shape and after-fix detector result in the real environment.

options.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing the real Cloudflare Sandbox cgroup and patched detector result before merge.

options.title: Accept Reporter-Sample Risk
options.body: Maintainers can merge based on the linked issue sample and tests, while explicitly owning any Cloudflare cgroup variant risk.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep the linked issue and this PR open until someone can provide real Cloudflare Sandbox proof.

recommendation.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing the real Cloudflare Sandbox cgroup and patched detector result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the closest same-surface detector precedent and is a practical routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency choice.
